why: The sign-in form's Show button sits inside the password field at its right end by design (JON-513): the field keeps 78 px of padding on its right for it (the button is 64 px wide, 5 px from the edge), so nothing typed is ever under it. Seen once v0.31.4 (the layout sweep) met v0.31.3's sign-in help.

Since JON-517 a session gets a short title (3 to 7 words) after its first turn, so one made by this version is not cut. The sweep still meets sessions that have none: those made before it (not titled in bulk, by design: no surprise spend), one whose first turn is not over yet, and one whose title could not be made (no Haiku model there). In the Projects list they show their first prompt, cut with an ellipsis (the full text in the row's tooltip). Remove this entry once the reference stack holds only sessions with a short title.

The quick-command form's "Run it" checkbox measures about 23 px at 320 px (it was at the 24 px boundary in v0.61.0). Pre-existing and unrelated to JON-1158, which does not touch that form. The real fix (a larger hit area for the checkbox) is tracked in JON-1220; remove this entry with that change.
